Subject: Marketplace experience flow and TOS clarity

Hi Jill,

Thanks again for taking time today. Attaching our draft page copy and a SKU/entitlements mapping. Quick asks:

- Can you confirm whether AcmeCloud's procurement flow supports "metered billing" vs "seat-based" per-SKU? We need this to map our pricing tiers.
- Are there marketplace entitlements that will block Access to VPC / Private Offer flows? We need to surface that on the listing.
- Any mandatory wording for the Terms of Service or Data Processing Addendum on the public listing page?

Attachments: DraftListingCopy_v3.docx (draft product page copy), AMI_sku_map.csv (SKU/entitlement mapping)

Proposed next step: 30-min alignment Tuesday to lock the copy and confirm entitlements for the private offer.

Thanks,

Stephanie
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Jill Torres <jill.torres@acmecloud.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeCloud Marketplace Ops <marketplace@acmecloud.com>, Mike Reynolds <mike.reynolds@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace experience flow and TOS clarity

Hey Stephanie,

Appreciate the materials — good start. Quick answers up front:

- AcmeCloud supports both metered billing and seat-based SKUs, but metered SKUs require a usage-reporting integration. We can accept metered SKUs for private offers, but billing reconciliation is handled at the buyer-account level (so you'll need clear usage metrics surfaced on your invoice).
- There are two entitlement gates to highlight: (1) VPC/Private Offer requires seller to be enrolled in our private offers program and have an approved AMI listing; (2) Some enterprise buyers require an additional Security Assessment checkbox (we can add a listing callout).
- For public listing TOS: include a short statement that customers accept AcmeCloud marketplace terms and link to your DPA. We need the DPA link live before public listing goes active.

I put Marketplace Ops on Cc to start the enrollment checklist. Attaching our private-offer enrollment template and a sample AMI checklist.

Can you confirm by EOD Monday whether you want to proceed with metered SKUs or a seat-only launch? If metered, well schedule an integration call with billing engineering.

Best,
Jill
Marketplace Partnerships
AcmeCloud
[Attachment: ACME_PrivateOffer_Template.pdf]

Stephanie / team —

Quick internal summary and proposed edits after reviewing Jill's notes (see quoted message below). Key points: 

1) Landing copy: add a short callout under "Pricing & Billing" that reads: "Available as seat-based or metered usage (metered requires usage-reporting integration; contact sales for enablement)."

2) TOS/DPA: we should add a footer link to the DPA and a short line: "Customers purchasing via AcmeCloud agree to AcmeCloud Marketplace Terms; see our DPA for data handling details." Laura — can you draft the footer DPA link and legal-approved line?

3) Private Offer flow: Soojin, please lead the AMI checklist updates (AMI tags, sellerid mapping, entitlement flags). I attached an updated SKU matrix that maps our internal SKUs to Acme entitlement ids.

Attachments referenced: Updated_SKU_Matrix.xlsx (internal), Proposed_Landing_Copy_v4.docx

If we confirm seat-only launch by Monday, we can submit a minimal public listing and keep metered SKUs disabled to avoid the integration ramp. If customers push for metered pricing we can enable it as a private-offer add-on.

Onwards,
Ben
Senior PM, GTM
Redwood Inference
